title: Phase 51H-1: Scenario state route family golden characterization
scope: Characterize POST /scenarios/state/draft and POST /scenarios/state/discard in main_web.py. Pin all current behavior, side effects, quirks, and response shapes. No extraction yet (that is 51H-2).

characterized_routes.purpose: Persist unsaved workspace edits without promoting them to saved-scenario authority.
characterized_routes.auth_quirk: Returns 401 JSON on no user (NOT 302 redirect to /login)

characterized_routes.purpose: Discard unsaved workspace edits and restore the last saved scenario boundary.
characterized_routes.auth_quirk: Returns 401 JSON on no user (NOT 302 redirect to /login)

discard_route_helpers: save_workspace_state(...) (repository, 1× fallback if discard returned None)

draft.args: user_id=user.user_id, project_id=project_record.project_id, project_code=project_code, draft_snapshot=snapshot, saved_snapshot=saved_snapshot (existing or baseline), dirty=not snapshots_equal(snapshot, saved_snapshot), governance_state=_governance_snapshot(project_code), replay_metadata=_replay_metadata_for_project(project_code, project_id=project_record.project_id, scenario_id=active_scenario_id, export_type='workspace_draft_state')

discard.args_when_fallback: user_id=user.user_id, project_id=project_record.project_id, project_code=project_code, draft_snapshot=baseline_snapshot, saved_snapshot=baseline_snapshot, dirty=False, governance_state=_governance_snapshot(project_code), replay_metadata=_replay_metadata_for_project(project_code, project_id=project_record.project_id, export_type='workspace_draft_state')
discard.note: Only called when discard_workspace_draft returns None (no existing workspace_state). The repository's discard_workspace_draft function internally calls save_workspace_state to UPDATE the row, so the discard path always results in 1-2 writes.

forbidden_side_effects_absent.save_project: NOT called (0 occurrences in route body; _project_workspace_from_snapshot may call it indirectly for unknown projects, but that's a pre-existing helper, not a route-introduced side effect)

draft: Authenticated + valid form → 200 + JSON payload with required keys
Authenticated + unknown active_project → 200 + JSON (falls back to factory_template project)
user_id derived from session, never from form
saved_snapshot = existing.saved_snapshot OR project baseline_snapshot OR default
Response message is a fixed string
Response does NOT have HX-Trigger header
Response does NOT have HX-Redirect header
discard: Authenticated + valid form → 200 + JSON payload with required keys + snapshot
Authenticated + unknown active_project → 200 + JSON (falls back to factory_template project)
user_id derived from session, never from form
If discard_workspace_draft returns None, calls save_workspace_state as fallback with baseline_snapshot
Response message is a fixed string
Response does NOT have HX-Trigger header
Response does NOT have HX-Redirect header

behavior_quirks: Quirk 1: Draft message is a fixed string 'Workspace draft captured. Saved scenario authority is unchanged.'
Quirk 2: Discard message is a fixed string 'Unsaved edits discarded. Workspace restored to the last saved runtime boundary.'
Quirk 3: Discard response includes 'snapshot' key (full draft_snapshot dict); draft does NOT include it
Quirk 4: Draft reads 'current_saved_scenario_id' from form (when no existing workspace) OR uses existing.active_scenario_id (when existing)
Quirk 5: Draft replay_metadata uses scenario_id=active_scenario_id when present (NOT when None)
Quirk 6: Discard fallback creates a clean workspace when no existing one (dirty=False, draft_snapshot=saved_snapshot=baseline_snapshot)
Quirk 7: Draft does NOT modify last_runtime_* fields (preserved by repository)
Quirk 8: Discard keeps last_runtime_* fields (preserved by discard_workspace_draft)
Quirk 9: Unauth returns 401 JSON, NOT 302 redirect to /login (unlike /save-run and /run which return 302)
Quirk 10: No HX-Trigger header (unlike /save-run which sets HX-Trigger: refreshHistory)
Quirk 11: Routes do NOT validate form fields strictly (no _validate_form call); they accept any form input as a snapshot
Quirk 12: Routes do NOT check for HTMX-request header; they respond the same way for HTMX and non-HTMX callers

helpers: resolve_runtime_snapshot(*, user, project_record, workspace_state, runtime_origin) -> RuntimeSnapshotResolution
existing_scenario_state_service_helpers.no_route_orchestration: True (no execute_*_route, no ScenarioStateRouteOutcome, no deps class)

Rejected because it would mix data-layer (no Request, no form, no auth) with route-layer (Request, form, auth) concerns, increasing the module's surface area and import-cycle risk.

remaining_risks: Adjacent /scenarios/* routes (/scenarios/save, /scenarios/{id}/*) are NOT in 51H-1 scope; they are separate route families and would need their own characterization + extraction phases (51I-1 / 51I-2, etc.).

The two routes in scope are JSON-only (not HTMX-partial-based). This is a meaningful difference from /run, /save-run, /compare, /validate, /download (all of which return HTMX-rendered templates). The extraction in 51H-2 should keep the JSON-only pattern.

discard_workspace_draft is a thin repository function that internally calls save_workspace_state. The discard route therefore does 1-2 writes per call. This is the intended behavior (preserved in 51H-1 quirks 6 and 8).
There is no ScenarioStateRouteDeps class yet. 51H-2 will introduce one. The 51H-1 test suite does not pin its shape; only the route-level behavior is pinned.

scenario_state_service.py currently has 4 data-layer helpers. 51H-2 may want to add more helpers here (e.g. a 'resolve workspace_state for user+project' that the discard route could use) but that is a refactor decision, not a behavior change.
All 12 behavior quirks are pinned at the route level. 51H-2 should preserve them when extracting. The 51H-1 test suite (92 tests) is the regression net for 51H-2.
recommended_next_phase: Phase 51H-2 (separate PR with explicit user sign-off) — Vertical extraction of POST /scenarios/state/draft and POST /scenarios/state/discard into app/services/scenario_state_route_service.py. Follow the Phase 51B/51C-2/51D-2/51E-2/51G-2 canonical pattern. Preserve all 12 characterized quirks, all intended side effects (save_workspace_state / discard_workspace_draft), and all forbidden side effects. After 51H-2: Phase 51I-1 + 51I-2 (project save-as service family). Optional Phase 51J: structural guardrail (export_service.py / export_audit_service.py does NOT import main_web).
